semiconductor_relevance: High — Hung Shin Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in supplying equipment and materials for semiconductor wet processes, which are critical in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Hung Shin Technology Co., Ltd. provides essential equipment and materials for semiconductor wet processes, including chemical pumps and PFA fittings. The company focuses on enhancing production efficiency and yield for semiconductor and optoelectronics manufacturers through superior technical support and equipment modifications.
capabilities: PFA valves and fittings for cleaning processes
Wet process equipment design and modification
